kpis.name: Multifamily same-store occupancy rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of occupied apartments in comparable multifamily assets.
kpis.description: The multifamily same-store occupancy rate declined from 94.8% at the end of 2024 to 90.4% at the end of 2025, driven in part by job losses in the district.
kpis.signal: Deterioration in residential demand in the DC region following job losses

kpis.name: Effective rent change on renewal
kpis.explanation: Average change in rent upon renewal of multifamily leases.
kpis.description: In 2025, effective rents increased by 5.0% on renewals, compared to a 1.1% decline on new leases. The renewal rate was 56.2%.
kpis.signal: Ability to raise rents for loyal tenants, contrasting with a 1.1% decline on new leases

kpis.name: Gross asset sales proceeds

kpis.description: In 2025, JBGS sold three multifamily assets and two development parcels for $554 million in gross proceeds, plus a 40% interest in a multifamily asset for an additional $100 million.
kpis.signal: Active asset recycling strategy in multifamily to fund opportunistic acquisitions

kpis.name: Real estate acquisitions

kpis.signal: Capitalizing on distressed office real estate acquisitions for value opportunities

risks.title: Office demand decline
risks.summary: Demand for office space has declined since 2020 and continues to weaken due to remote work and reduced leased space. Office occupancy decreased by 140 bps to 75.1% in 2025 compared to 76.5% in 2024.
risks.score_rationale: The company faces office demand decline risk due to the persistent trend toward remote work and reduced leased space by companies. Offices represent a significant portion of the portfolio. Office occupancy declined to 75.1% in 2025.

risks.title: Geographic concentration
risks.summary: The company's geographic concentration in the Washington D.C. region (particularly National Landing) makes it vulnerable to economic and political conditions in this area. Job losses in the district have already impacted multifamily occupancy.
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly concentrated in the Washington D.C. region, making it vulnerable to economic and political conditions in this area.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in its filed documents. Its core business appears to be focused on real estate.
